profiles.name: default
profiles.description: Balanced profile used for the standalone prototype.
profiles.summary: Runs 21 checks of training quality, model behaviour and operational readiness, then recommends promote, hold or rollback.
profiles.strictness_text: Recommends promotion at a score of 75 or more and rollback below 50. 4 critical rules force a rollback whatever the score, and 4 checks must pass before promotion. A check that could not run is flagged and never counted as a pass.
profiles.unavailable_reason: It would load the model file without scanning it first. Loading a model runs the code inside it, so this server only runs profiles that scan the file before loading it.

profiles.name: extended
profiles.description: Default checks plus conflicting labels, training duplicates, model-file safety and CPU time.
profiles.summary: Runs 25 checks of training quality, model behaviour and operational readiness, then recommends promote, hold or rollback.
highlights: Scans the model file before loading it
Also checks conflicting labels in the evaluation data, repeated training rows and how much CPU the model uses
profiles.strictness_text: Recommends promotion at a score of 75 or more and rollback below 50. 5 critical rules force a rollback whatever the score, and 6 checks must pass before promotion. A check that could not run is flagged and never counted as a pass.

profiles.name: extended_hidden_groups
